title.label: wispr flow is a low-key fire app

content.label: i first came across wispr flow while watching tiktoks of this guy trying to get into 100% acceptance rate colleges or well pranking 100% acceptance rate colleges. i was like "you know what? why not? i'll try a product i see advertised on tiktok." so i downloaded wispr flow. it may slow down my computer a bunch and get in my way a bunch on my computer but it's great. i love it. and it's even better on the phone because typing even though i'm fast at it on my phone takes a long time.
